text:
Type: woven-back swivel desk armchair
Use: working at a desk; home office, study, living room corner
Style: contemporary, bohemian, modern
Materials: woven synthetic rattan back and seat frame, padded fabric seat cushion, black steel tube armrests and five-star base, casters
Colors: black brown, charcoal grey cushion, black
Shape: low rounded open-weave back wrapping into slim tubular armrests, thick padded seat, column on a five-star base with casters, medium visual weight
Feel: textured, relaxed, cozy, understated
Goes with: dark wood or black desks, natural fibers, warm grey tones; contemporary or bohemian home offices

product.name: GREGOR
product.description: You sit comfortably since the chair is adjustable in height.
